list.title: Around Sinchon & Yeonnam: guesthouse starter map
list.desc: A starter map made by PinWith for guests staying around Sinchon, Hongdae and Yeonnam-dong: stations, everyday errands, cafes and cheap eats within walking distance. Not made by Kimchee Guesthouse.

items.title: Hongik Univ. Station (홍대입구역)
items.memo: Line 2, AREX airport railroad and Gyeongui-Jungang line in one station.

items.title: Sinchon Station (신촌역, Line 2)
items.memo: Line 2 stop for Yonsei and Sinchon's main streets; one stop from Hongdae.

items.title: Sinchon No.1 Pharmacy (신촌1번약국)
items.memo: Pharmacy steps from Sinchon Stn; open daily, to 10pm on weekdays.

items.title: Hongik Pharmacy (홍익약국)
items.memo: Pharmacy by Hongik Univ. Stn, open daily until 11:30pm.

items.title: WASH PLANT laundromat
items.memo: 24-hour self laundromat in Donggyo-dong; coin changer, detergent included.

items.title: Olive Young Sinchon-ro
items.memo: Toiletries and skincare by Sinchon Stn; open 10am-10:30pm.

items.title: Hyundai Department Store Sinchon
items.memo: Basement supermarket and food hall; restaurants on the 10th floor.

items.title: Gyeongui Line Forest Park, Yeonnam (경의선숲길)
items.memo: Old rail line turned park ('Yeontral Park'); open 24 hours.

items.title: Yonsei University, Sinchon Campus
items.memo: Campus open for a walk, north end of Yonsei-ro.

items.title: Coffee Libre Yeonnam
items.memo: Specialty roaster in Yeonnam's back streets; beans to take home.

items.title: Hyangmi (향미)
items.memo: Yeonnam Chinese spot: dumplings, xiaolongbao, beef noodle soup.

items.title: Sosin Isso
items.memo: Braised short rib stew with glass noodles; 5 spice levels, near Yonsei-ro.
